differences.subject: playground_flag
differences.description: The flag on the play tower is present in the first panel and absent in the second.

differences.subject: tree_blossoms
differences.description: Small blossoms appear among the tree branches in the second panel.

differences.subject: boy_shirt
differences.description: The boy's shirt has a star in the first panel and horizontal stripes in the second.

differences.subject: middle_foreground_flower
differences.description: The middle flower in the foreground row changes from a daisy to a tulip.

differences.subject: play_tower_lower_opening
differences.description: The lower tower opening is round in the first panel and arched in the second.

differences.subject: dog_toy
differences.description: The toy beside the dog changes from yellow and blue to red.

differences.subject: sky_birds
differences.description: Two birds appear in the sky in the second panel; none are visible in the first.

differences.subject: grape_above_board
differences.description: A single purple grape appears on the tabletop above the board in the second panel.

differences.subject: top_center_craft_piece
differences.description: The small raised craft piece near the top center changes from turquoise to green.

differences.subject: lower_right_chocolate_donut
differences.description: The lower-right chocolate donut has multicolored sprinkles in the first panel and blue and yellow sprinkles in the second.

differences.subject: striped_beach_umbrella
differences.description: The striped umbrella near the right side changes from blue and white to brown and white.
